exec: const norm = function (s) { return String(s).normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').toLowerCase(); };
const getJson = function () { try { return pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { return null; } };
const cuerpo = function () { const j = getJson(); return norm(j === null ? pm.response.text() : JSON.stringify(j)); };
const listaDe = function (j) { if (Array.isArray(j)) { return j; } if (j && typeof j === 'object') { return j.content || j.alertas || j.items || j.prendas || j.data || null; } return null; };
const runV = function () { return String(pm.collectionVariables.get('run') || ''); };

const pid = function (a) { if (!a) { return ''; } const p = a.prendaId !== undefined ? a.prendaId : (a.idPrenda !== undefined ? a.idPrenda : a.prenda); if (p && typeof p === 'object') { return String(p.id); } return String(p); };

const pnom = function (a) { const p = a && a.prenda; if (p && typeof p === 'object') { return String(p.nombre || ''); } return String((a && (a.prendaNombre || a.nombrePrenda || a.nombre)) || (typeof p === 'string' ? p : '')); };

const esMia = function (a, id, tag) { if (!a) { return false; } return pid(a) === String(id) || (Array.isArray(a.tallas) && String(a.id) === String(id)) || norm(pnom(a)).indexOf(norm(tag + ' ' + runV())) >= 0; };
const mias = function (id, tag) { return (listaDe(getJson()) || []).filter(function (a) { return esMia(a, id, tag); }); };

const tallasMias = function (id, tag) { const out = []; mias(id, tag).forEach(function (it) { if (Array.isArray(it.tallas)) { it.tallas.forEach(function (t) { out.push(t); }); } else if (it.talla !== undefined) { out.push(it); } }); return out; };
const tallaMia = function (id, tag, t) { return tallasMias(id, tag).find(function (x) { return String(x.talla) === String(t); }); };
